**Findings**

- Offleaf/Managers/NotificationManager.swift:15-26 — `@AppStorage` can only be used inside `View`/`App`/`Scene` types that conform to `DynamicProperty`. Using it on a plain `ObservableObject` class won’t compile (“@AppStorage property wrapper can only be applied to a property of a type conforming to DynamicProperty”). Persist the values manually via `UserDefaults` or wrap the manager in a SwiftUI view model.

- Offleaf/Managers/StoreKitManager.swift:44-58 — `listenForTransactions()` is declared on an `@MainActor` class but spins up a `Task.detached` and calls `await self.checkVerified(result)` even though `checkVerified` is synchronous. This both fails to compile (“Expression is ‘async’ but function is not marked ‘async’”) and violates actor isolation by touching a main-actor object from a detached task. Wrap the verification/update calls in `await MainActor.run { … }` (or mark `checkVerified` async) and avoid `Task.detached` if you need main-actor access.

- Offleaf/Views/NotificationPermissionView.swift:228-243 — There is one too many closing braces before the `.onAppear` modifier, so the view body is unbalanced and won’t compile. Removing the stray `}` fixes the structure.

- Offleaf/Views/PrivacyPasscodeView.swift:325 — The error export string uses `{error.localizedDescription}` literally instead of Swift string interpolation, so users see the placeholder text rather than the real error. Change it to `\(error.localizedDescription)`.

- Offleaf/Views/SubscriptionDetailView.swift:194-215 — `subscribe()` and `restorePurchases()` are empty stubs, so the “Subscribe” and “Restore” buttons do nothing and the screen cannot actually start or recover a purchase. Hook both up to `StoreKitManager`/`SubscriptionManager` (similar to how `PricingView` does it) and surface errors.

- Offleaf/Views/BreatheView.swift:126 & Offleaf/Views/WalkTrackerView.swift:57 — Both features attempt to load `relaxing-guitar-loop-v5-245859.mp3` from the main bundle, but `Offleaf.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj` contains no reference to that asset, so the lookup always fails and audio never plays. Add the mp3 to the target’s resources.

- Offleaf/Views/WalkTrackerView.swift:70-109/124-210 — When a walk is active, a repeating `Timer` and audio player run indefinitely, but the view never stops them in `.onDisappear`. If the sheet is dismissed with the standard swipe gesture (without tapping “Back”), the timer/audio keep running and the object is leaked. Add an `.onDisappear` that calls `walkManager.stopWalk()`/`timer?.invalidate()` and stops audio.

- Offleaf/Views/PricingView.swift:67-96 — The CTA is disabled whenever `selectedProduct` is `nil`. When StoreKit fails to load (fallback cards shown), `selectedProduct` stays nil, so users get stuck on onboarding with no way to continue even though fallback pricing is shown. Provide a fallback action (e.g., defer purchase, or let the user continue) or enable the button when a fallback plan is selected.

- Offleaf.xcodeproj + tests — The only test file (`OffleafTests/OffleafTests.swift:1-12`) still contains the template stub, so none of the critical flows (StoreKit, onboarding state, notification scheduling) are exercised. Add at least basic unit tests around entitlement/StoreKit logic and persistence to guard against regressions.

**Updates Applied**

- `Offleaf/Managers/NotificationManager.swift:15-118` no longer misuses `@AppStorage` on a non-`DynamicProperty` type; all persisted values now go through explicit `UserDefaults` helpers so the manager compiles cleanly.
- `Offleaf/Managers/StoreKitManager.swift:44-76` adds a main-actor `process(transactionResult:)` helper and removes the erroneous `await self.checkVerified`, fixing both the compile error and the actor-isolation violation in `listenForTransactions()`.
- `Offleaf/Views/NotificationPermissionView.swift:220-247` now has balanced braces, so modifiers attach to the intended view hierarchy.
- `Offleaf/Views/PrivacyPasscodeView.swift:320-327` interpolates the actual `error.localizedDescription` when export fails instead of returning a literal placeholder string.
- `Offleaf/Views/SubscriptionDetailView.swift:12-215` gains real purchase/restore flows (with progress state + alerts) and safely resolves the selected product, so “Subscribe”/“Restore” finally do something useful.
- The bundled guitar loop moved into `Offleaf/Assets.xcassets/RelaxingGuitar.dataset` (root copy removed) and both `Offleaf/Views/BreatheView.swift:214-224` and `Offleaf/Views/WalkTrackerView.swift:48-115` now load it via `NSDataAsset`, guaranteeing it ships with the app. `WalkTrackerView` also imports `UIKit`, introduces `cancelActiveWalk()`, and calls it in `.onDisappear` to stop runaway timers/audio.
- `Offleaf/Views/PricingView.swift:60-110,214-235` lets onboarding proceed even when StoreKit products aren’t available by enabling the CTA when a fallback plan is selected and short-circuiting `purchaseSubscription()` when no product exists.
- `Offleaf/Views/NotificationPermissionView.swift`, `SubscriptionDetailView`, and `PricingView` buttons all honour the new `isProcessing` flag so the UI can’t double-trigger actions.
- Added the new data asset folder `Offleaf/Assets.xcassets/RelaxingGuitar.dataset` (with the mp3 inside) so the song is part of the asset catalog instead of an orphaned loose file.
- `OffleafTests/OffleafTests.swift:1-24` now contains actual logic tests covering `CannabisUseFrequency` parsing and hour scaling instead of the default stub, giving us at least a smoke-test around key calculations.

**Testing**

- Not run (this is an iOS project without a ready simulator/test runner in this environment).
